vercel.gitIntegration: Each merge to main starts a production build. The Production env holds CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY, so that build runs convex deploy first and then the Next build; a failed Next build stops the Convex push. Preview builds have no key, build only, and read the Convex dev deployment.

backend.prodDeploy: runs inside build:vercel on Vercel Production, only when CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY is set

gate.command: CI: Quality gate and PR hygiene / checks, then the Mergify queue

footguns.rule: Never deploy with a bare vercel CLI call. The one door is ~/bin/vercel-deploy, which checks the linked project against this manifest.
Keep CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY in the Production env only. In Preview it would let every preview build deploy Convex production.
